vectors.precondition: operator supplies complete Source Registry v4 governance and reviewed public data-policy record
vectors.expected: 201 and registered source with authorization digest and explicit data policy; raw evidence is absent from public status

vectors.precondition: source lacks permitted scope, terms, remedies, language, retention, crawl policy, or explicit public data policy
vectors.expected: fail closed; no source record and no crawl

vectors.precondition: registration or document requests a private, secret, operator, Wallet, Mail, Cloud, Social, strategy, or internal class
vectors.expected: SEARCH_DATA_CLASS_FORBIDDEN semantics; no source or document persistence

vectors.precondition: document class is public but absent from the source reviewed allowlist
vectors.expected: fail closed before persistence; source policy remains unchanged

vectors.precondition: otherwise public document contains a high-confidence credential, authorization header, internal branch, worktree, environment-file, or private-key pattern
vectors.expected: SEARCH_SENSITIVE_CONTENT_REJECTED semantics; no document persistence

vectors.precondition: registered hostname resolves to a loopback or private address
vectors.expected: no HTTP fetch, source failed with backoff, outbound destination rejection is observable

vectors.precondition: robots.txt disallows registered path
vectors.expected: blocked-by-robots; no document indexed

vectors.precondition: database contains a pre-v4 source without reviewed explicit public classes
vectors.expected: source disabled, migrationRequired=source-registry-v4, document excluded from Search and AI results

vectors.precondition: indexed reviewed document matches query
vectors.expected: result includes sourceUrl, sourceLabel, sourceScope, dataClass, freshness, score, snippet and indexReceiptDigest; response includes dataPolicyVersion; inference=false

vectors.precondition: approved source corpus is empty
vectors.expected: successful empty state and registered-authorized-sources-only coverage; no synthetic result

vectors.precondition: source is searchable but dataRights.aiRetrieval=false
vectors.expected: source is absent from AI context while remaining eligible for ordinary retrieval

vectors.precondition: client sends filters.aiRetrievalOnly=false to an AI route
vectors.expected: server overwrites the client value with true; ineligible sources remain absent

vectors.precondition: retrieved results exist but user has not approved context
vectors.expected: consent-required error; no provider request

vectors.precondition: AI provider cites a URL outside the retrieved set
vectors.expected: unindexed citation rejection; answer not accepted as verified

vectors.precondition: valid Search Wallet callback binding was consumed once
vectors.expected: replay rejection; exactly one callback consumption; no Product Session created locally

vectors.precondition: callback uses correct nonce but wrong product bundle
vectors.expected: binding rejection; no session

vectors.precondition: appeal does not reference an existing remedy case
vectors.expected: rejection with no orphan appeal

vectors.precondition: authorized removal decision references indexed source URL
vectors.expected: document removed, audit retained, canonical event emitted after Data Fabric integration

vectors.precondition: Search API is unavailable
vectors.expected: query preserved, retry visible, no fabricated result or signed action claim

vectors.precondition: query equals YNX
vectors.expected: canonical entity YNX Chain; no automatic correction to Lynx

vectors.precondition: query equals 6423
vectors.expected: canonical entity YNX Testnet with EVM chain ID 6423 and no Mainnet claim

vectors.precondition: local commit differs from staging health commit
vectors.expected: deployedStaging remains historical true, currentSourceDeployed=false, public and hosted states false

vectors.precondition: a Source Registry v4 backup object or its manifest has changed
vectors.expected: integrity rejection before destination creation

vectors.precondition: operator selects the live database, backup bundle, or an existing file
vectors.expected: fail closed; no overwrite and no in-place downgrade

vectors.precondition: backup contains metadata-only, snippet-only, or AI-ineligible sources
vectors.expected: source-use rights remain unchanged; prohibited snippets and AI context remain unavailable

vectors.precondition: request reaches any Search route
vectors.action: observe response and bounded structured log
vectors.expected: response has Request and Trace IDs; errors also have one matching Error ID; normalized log excludes query strings, bodies, IP addresses and error messages

vectors.precondition: no Search metrics bearer is configured
vectors.expected: 503 fail-closed response with correlation IDs; no metrics body or synthetic success

vectors.precondition: Search metrics bearer is configured
vectors.action: scrape without or with the wrong bearer, then with the accepted bearer
vectors.expected: unauthorized scrapes fail; accepted private scrape returns only bounded route/status/latency/error/uptime metrics with no user or source content labels

vectors.precondition: local loopback benchmark evidence exists
vectors.action: read the capacity evidence and release record
vectors.expected: environment, source commit, dataset, concurrency, latency and status counts are present; evidence remains labeled local and does not imply staging, public or production capacity
